Name: Low-Development Profile
Description: Countries in this cluster exhibit the weakest socioeconomic outcomes, including very low income and GDP per capita, high child mortality, low life expectancy, and high fertility. These characteristics indicate substantial development needs in healthcare, education, infrastructure, and economic development.
Example Countries: Albania, Antigua and Barbuda, Bahamas, Barbados, Belarus, Belize, Bhutan, Bosnia and Herzegovina

Name: Developing-Economy Profile
Description: Countries in this cluster show intermediate socioeconomic development, with moderate income, relatively favorable health outcomes, and continued economic and social development needs. The profile represents economies that have progressed beyond the lowest-development group but still face important development challenges.
Example Countries: Afghanistan, Angola, Benin, Botswana, Burkina Faso, Burundi, Cameroon, Central African Republic

Name: High-Income Trade-Oriented Profile
Description: Countries in this cluster have very high income and GDP per capita, exceptionally high trade intensity, strong health outcomes, and relatively low fertility. The profile is characterized by high economic capacity and substantial international trade exposure.
Example Countries: Bahrain, Brunei, Ireland, Kuwait, Luxembourg, Malta, Oman, Qatar

Name: Emerging-Economy Profile
Description: Countries in this cluster exhibit intermediate income and human-development outcomes, together with significant economic challenges such as relatively high inflation. The profile represents economies undergoing continued economic and socioeconomic development.
Example Countries: Algeria, Argentina, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Bangladesh, Bolivia, Brazil, China

Name: Advanced-Economy Profile
Description: Countries in this cluster exhibit the strongest human-development outcomes, including the highest life expectancy, lowest child mortality, low fertility, and high income and GDP per capita. These characteristics indicate advanced socioeconomic development and strong domestic economic capacity.
Example Countries: Australia, Austria, Belgium, Canada, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany
